name: Steam-blinded
unresistable: environmental: a phase of the Toll Collector's fight
desc: Applied to the Toll Collector by a heat spell. Its attacks have a 50% chance to miss for 8 seconds. Another heat spell resets the timer without adding to the effect.

name: Ice-locked Joints
unresistable: environmental: a phase of the Toll Collector's fight
desc: Applied to the Toll Collector by a cold spell. Its dodge is 0 and its armor is reduced by 75% for 8 seconds. Another cold spell resets the timer without adding to the effect.

name: Stamping Overdrive
unresistable: environmental: a phase of the Toll Collector's fight
desc: Applied to the Toll Collector by a lightning spell. Its attack speed is +65% for 8 seconds, and it takes 12 lightning damage each time its action bar fills. Another lightning spell resets the timer without adding to the effect.

name: Eyeless
desc: Cannot be Dazzled or Blinded. No other effect.

name: Refutation
desc: Ward absorbs a flat 40 damage from each hit after resistances, plus 1.5 per point of spell power, for 15 seconds. Anything that strikes you in melee takes 6 piercing damage and is Punctured.

name: Knitting
desc: Health regenerates. Heat or acid damage removes it and applies Doused for 4 seconds.

name: Doused
desc: Health regeneration is zero for 4 seconds. Knitting cannot return until it ends.

name: Corroded
desc: Armour is reduced by 12% per point of corrosion for 25 seconds. Doses add; at 6 it escalates to Melting.

name: Melting
desc: Armour gives nothing for 15 seconds. Bludgeoning, heat and cold resistance each drop by 12%.

name: Poisoned
desc: Deals 0.05 poison damage per tick per intensity for 30 seconds and cuts stamina regeneration by 20%. Only a stronger dose replaces it; at intensity 4 it escalates to Rotting. A poison cure (a Mendroot Salve) removes it.

name: Rotting
desc: Deals 0.12 poison damage per tick per intensity for 45 seconds and cuts stamina regeneration by 35%. Half of every stamina spend is also removed from maximum stamina, up to 60%. When it ends the lost maximum returns slowly (Wasted). A poison cure (a Mendroot Salve) reduces it to Poisoned.

name: Wasted
desc: Maximum stamina removed by Rotting returns over time, about 20 seconds for a full 60% loss.

name: On Fire
desc: Deals 0.4 heat damage per tick per intensity for 8 seconds. A new flame adds half its intensity to the existing one without resetting the timer. At intensity 5 it escalates to Blazing.

name: Blazing
desc: Deals 0.9 heat damage per tick per intensity for 4 seconds. Healing can restore at most half of what it burns. When it ends it becomes Seared.

name: Seared
desc: Healing can restore at most half of what the blaze burned. No timer. Removed by rest, a salve, or a healing spell.

name: Sweltering
desc: Maximum stamina: -5% per point of intensity, up to -30%. Duration: 30 seconds, renewed by each dose. Doses add up to 6; it does not escalate. Source: a heatwave under an open sky.

name: Chilled
desc: Speed is reduced by 40% and weapon bonuses by 50% per intensity (up to 60%) for 20 seconds. Doses add; past intensity 1 it escalates to Frozen.

name: Frozen
desc: Speed is reduced by 95% and bludgeoning resistance by 50% for 3 seconds. Any damage taken removes it.

name: Rattled
desc: Slowed until its next action. Lost speed is the share of its blow that Heavy stance cut, times 2/3.

name: Petrified
unresistable: a statue: the Stone already decided it
desc: Cannot act. Lasts 3 s. Broken before then, it throws its max HP as rocks at the enemies behind it. Gives 50% of its gold as Stone Chunks and 50% XP.

name: Petrified
unresistable: a statue: the Stone already decided it
desc: Cannot act. Lasts 3 s. Broken before then, it throws its max HP as rocks at the enemies behind it. Unbroken, it bursts for half that. Gives no gold and 50% XP.

name: Petrified
unresistable: a statue: the Stone already decided it
desc: Cannot act. Stays until the fight ends. Your attacks skip it. Throws no rocks. Gives 50% of its gold as Stone Chunks and 50% XP when the fight ends.

name: Bleeding
desc: Deals 0.08 slashing damage per tick plus 0.15% of current health, at 30% rate out of combat. No timer. Each cut is its own stack; at 5 it escalates to Lacerated. Removed only by rest, a salve, a healing spell, or a bleed cure (a Mendroot Salve).

name: Lacerated
desc: Deals 0.2% of maximum health per tick as slashing damage (30% rate out of combat) and reduces maximum health by 4% per stack, up to 30%. No timer. Rest, a salve (a Mendroot Salve included), or a healing spell reduces it to Bleeding; a second treatment closes that.

name: Concussed
desc: Spells cannot be cast and attacks have a 12% miss chance per intensity, for 25 seconds. Rest, a salve, or a healing spell reduces its intensity by 40%. At intensity 3 it escalates to Dazed.

name: Dazed
desc: Spells and attacks cannot be taken. Each stack skips one completed action and is spent by it. Ends with the fight.

name: Punctured
desc: Stamina costs rise by 25% per point (up to double). Each tick it is held, maximum stamina is reduced by another 0.04% (0.4% per second), up to 5%. Lasts 40 seconds. Doses add; at 3 it escalates to Perforated.

name: Perforated
desc: Stamina does not regenerate, maximum stamina is reduced by 5% per stack (up to 40%), and the stance is forced to Balanced. Lasts 60 seconds.

name: Jolted
desc: Deals 1.2 lightning damage per intensity each time your action bar fills, for 20 seconds. Below 50% health you drop your weapon. Taking damage halves its intensity. Past intensity 2 each new dose may escalate it to Shocked; at 6 it does.

name: Shocked
desc: The action bar drains instead of filling. When it empties, the bearer takes 2.5 lightning damage per intensity and the condition ends. Ends with the fight.

name: Shardbound
desc: Deals 0.8 piercing damage per intensity to the bearer each time they attack or are struck in melee, for 30 seconds. Doses add; at 4 it escalates to Shardbloom.

name: Shardbloom
desc: Deals 0.4 piercing damage per intensity to the bearer each time they attack or are struck in melee, and applies a Shard Cut each time. Lasts 25 seconds.

name: Shard Cut
desc: Deals 0.3 slashing damage per tick plus 0.1% of current health, for 4 seconds. Stacks up to 8 and never escalates.

name: Wet
desc: Heat resistance +8%; lightning and cold resistance -6%; poison resistance -4%. Lasts 30 seconds. Doses add; at 5 it escalates to Soaked. Heat damage removes one stack.

name: Soaked
desc: Heat resistance is set to 80% (or raised by 10% if it is already 80% or more). Lightning, cold and poison resistance are set to -50%. Chill lands at triple intensity, and Jolted escalates at intensity 3. When Soaked first lands, any Poison already on the bearer becomes Rotting at 2/3 of its intensity. Lasts 60 seconds or until the bearer takes 3 hits of heat, poison, lightning or cold damage.

name: Buffeted
desc: Each point gives a 12% chance that a technique ends off balance instead of at its exit position, fading as the 12-second timer runs down. Doses add; at 5 it escalates to Unfooted. A plain swing still resets to neutral.

name: Unfooted
desc: Every technique ends off balance instead of at its exit position, for 20 seconds. A plain swing still resets to neutral.

name: Seeded
desc: No effect on landing. Its intensity rises 0.15 per second during a fight, and at 6 it becomes Rootbound. Each hit the bearer takes lowers its intensity by 0.5 (by 1 if the hit is piercing); each water hit raises it by 1. It records the intensity of every other condition applied to the bearer (up to 6 per condition). Heat damage removes it and deals 4 heat damage per recorded intensity.

name: Rootbound
desc: Speed -20%, dodge -8%. Every 3 seconds, 25% of the recorded conditions are applied to every other enemy in the fight. Its intensity rises 0.08 per second during a fight; each hit the bearer takes lowers it by 0.25 (by 0.5 if piercing) and each water hit raises it by 0.5. Lasts 45 seconds. Heat damage removes it and deals 7 heat damage per recorded intensity.

name: Overgrown
desc: Applied when you heal an enemy with a spell: the full amount healed is added to its surplus, whether or not it was wounded. Speed -15%, dodge -5%. The surplus shrinks by about 2% of itself every second. At surplus equal to 50% of its maximum health it escalates to Proliferating.

name: Proliferating
desc: Speed -30%, dodge -10%. The surplus shrinks by about 1% of itself every second. At surplus equal to 100% of its maximum health it bursts: the bearer takes the whole surplus as damage, and every other enemy takes half of it as poison damage.

name: Magnetized
desc: Each point gives attacks a 10% chance to ignore the bearer’s dodge, and lowers its dodge by 3%. Lightning attacks always ignore its dodge. Piercing attacks gain 5% crit chance per point. Lasts 10 seconds. Doses add; at 6 it escalates to Magnet-Locked.

name: Magnet-Locked
desc: Dodge does not apply at all. Lightning attacks cannot miss them. Piercing attacks gain 5% crit chance per stack, and the next critical hit deals +35% damage per stack. Lasts 15 seconds.

name: Dazzled
desc: Attacks have an 8% miss chance per intensity and dodge is reduced by 5%. Lasts 6 seconds; a second flash extends the timer. At 4 it escalates to Blinded.

name: Blinded
desc: Every attack rolls to hit twice and keeps the worse result. Dodge is reduced by 25%. Lasts 25 seconds.

name: Tainted
desc: All resistances are reduced by 5% per stack, light and dark by 10%. Its penalty cannot push a resistance below -25% (a further -5% for each stack past the first); a resistance already lower is left as it is. Weakens as the 45-second timer runs down. Doses add; at 5 it escalates to Corrupted.

name: Corrupted
desc: Each stack reduces maximum spirit by 10% and maximum health, stamina and mana by 5% (up to 60%). Up to 10 stacks. No timer; only a cleansing removes it. If spirit reaches zero you are defeated and wake with half of it.

name: Manaburn
desc: Drains 1% of maximum mana per tick until mana equal to its intensity has been drained, then it ends. Mana can go below zero, down to -100% of maximum mana plus a further -25% for each stack past the first. When mana reaches that limit, it deals arcane damage equal to the mana debt, ignoring 80% of arcane resistance, and ends. No timer.

name: Well Fed
desc: Restores 0.06% of maximum health per tick, +8 maximum health and +10% stamina regeneration for 10 minutes.

name: Steady Hand
desc: +3% crit and +2% parry for 8 minutes.

name: Clear-Headed
desc: Restores 0.1% of maximum mana per tick, +8% spell power and +5% skill experience for 8 minutes.

name: Stoked
desc: +5% damage and +0.05 critical damage multiplier per intensity, for 5 minutes. Granted by Seared Stew.

name: Steeped
desc: +25% poison resistance and +10% acid resistance per intensity, for 10 minutes. Granted by Steeped Broth. Poison or acid resistance of 100% or more stops those conditions from landing; damage resistance still stops at its cap.

name: Queasy
desc: Deals 0.03 poison damage per tick and cuts stamina regeneration by 25% for 90 seconds. Rest removes it.

name: Frosted
desc: +20% cold resistance and +10% heat resistance per intensity. Lasts as long as the Elixir. Granted by Frostmoss.

name: Concealed
desc: Attacks against you have a 10% chance to miss and you gain +3% dodge, per intensity. Lasts as long as the Elixir. Granted by Gloomcap.

name: Invigorated
desc: +25% stamina regeneration per intensity. Lasts as long as the Elixir. Granted by Bloodwort.

name: Unfolded
desc: Slashing, piercing and bludgeoning resistance -12%; arcane resistance -15%. Lasts 15 seconds.

name: Folded Space
desc: +12% dodge for 40 seconds.

name: Xima's Rime
desc: +12% heat, cold and lightning resistance for 60 seconds. Granted by Xima.

name: Blood Communion
desc: Bleeding and Lacerated ticks heal you instead of damaging you. +8% damage. Lasts 60 seconds.

name: Honor Bound
desc: Enemies other than your target do not attack. +10% damage. Lasts 20 seconds.

name: Veiled
desc: Attacks against you have a 12% chance to miss, for 30 seconds.

name: Night Shroud
desc: Attacks against you have a 12% chance to miss, for 30 seconds.

name: Unravelling
desc: Arcane resistance -8%, spell power -5% and mana regeneration -15% per stack, for 20 seconds. At 3 stacks it becomes Manaburn at 8 times the intensity.

name: Kinetic Bulwark
desc: Blocks all ranged attacks except light, for 25 seconds.

name: Kinetic Haste
desc: +3% speed and +3% travel speed per intensity, for 20 seconds. Speed covers attacks, crafting and every activity.

name: Braced
desc: +1 armour per intensity, for 20 seconds.

name: Rooted
desc: +2% bludgeoning resistance per intensity, for 20 seconds. Dazed and Concussed land at half intensity.

name: Foresight
desc: Attacks against you have a 3% chance to miss per intensity, for 20 seconds.

name: Compressed
desc: Speed -2% per intensity, for 20 seconds.

name: Read
desc: Dodge -2% and parry -2% per intensity, for 20 seconds.

name: Wide Sight
desc: +1.2% slashing, piercing and bludgeoning resistance per intensity, for 20 seconds.

name: Artisan's Cunning
desc: +15% craft speed and +8% loot for 120 seconds.

name: Flat-Footed
unresistable: state: caught off guard, not an element
desc: Dodge and parry from gear, affixes, runes, hand bonuses, buffs and conditions do not apply; skill and title bonuses still do. Ends after your next two completed actions.

name: Surprised
unresistable: state: caught off guard, not an element
desc: The next hit to land deals 30% more damage per intensity, then the surprise is spent. A fight opening on surprised enemies starts your action bar nearly full. Fades after two of their actions.

name: Skewered
desc: Speed -5% and dodge -15% for 10 seconds. If the timer runs out, the bearer takes 12 piercing damage per intensity; if it is removed early, no damage is dealt.

name: Fasting
unresistable: unique: Anupama's rule, not an affliction
desc: Plain weapon swings cannot be used. Spells, techniques and abilities still can. Ends with the fight.

name: Hunger
desc: Deals 0.05 dark damage per tick per intensity; half of it ignores resistance. No cap on stacks. Each application refreshes the 15-second timer. Ends with the fight.

name: The Weight of Hunger
desc: Speed is reduced by intensity, to at most 3 times slower. Ends when your action bar fills, or after 3 seconds.
